                if v407.icon ~= "" then
                    pcall(function()
                        v412:SetThumbnail(v407.icon)
                    end)
                end

                n3 += 1

                if n3 >= t2.value8.GRID_COLUMNS then
                    n3 = 0

                    if i % (t2.value8.GRID_COLUMNS * 4) == 0 then
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
